metric_descriptions.heatmap_cosine_distance: per-scale per-block cosine distance (1 - cos_sim), rows=scales, cols=blocks
metric_descriptions.heatmap_macro_nrmse: per-scale per-block macro-averaged NRMSE (%), equal weight per dim, energy threshold >1%
metric_descriptions.token_disagree_per_scale: fraction of tokens that differ from baseline at each scale
metric_descriptions.fhat_nrmse_per_scale: NRMSE (%) of the accumulated f_hat latent map after each scale
metric_descriptions.fhat_cosine_distance_per_scale: cosine distance of f_hat latent map at each scale
metric_descriptions.fhat_spatial_cos_per_scale: per-spatial-position f_hat cosine distance (num_stages, H, W), rows=scales, then H×W spatial
metric_descriptions.fhat_spatial_cos_mean_per_scale: mean per-position f_hat cosine distance per scale
metric_descriptions.decoded_psnr_scale9: PSNR (dB) of VAE-decoded 256×256 image from scale-9 f_hat
metric_descriptions.decoded_nrmse_percent_scale9: NRMSE (%) of VAE-decoded 256×256 image from scale-9 f_hat
